# Survey Response

## Summary
One submitted answer set. Answers are SNAPSHOTS — each row embeds the
prompt text it answered alongside the response, and `surveyTitle` snapshots
the title, so editing the Survey later never rewrites what a respondent
actually saw and said.

## API
- `survey` — linksTo the Survey it answers (for counting and navigation)
- `surveyTitle` — snapshot of the title at submission time
- `answers` — containsMany SurveyAnswer (`{ prompt, response }` snapshots)

## Invariant
Treat instances as immutable once submitted: corrections are a new
response, not an edit.

The linked example is a real submitted match-day response.
